reviews.text:
Super friendly staff!
Very professional veterinary Doctors!
Dr. King Moon and Dr. Ravivo

I adopted an older dog about a year ago, and the staff here have been amazing! My dog needed a couple surgeries (dental/cherry eye correction) and Dr Moon was so skilled and communicative in the weeks later for check-ups on how my dog was doing. I love this place and can't recommend it enough!

Dr.King Moon is fer lack of a less evasive term BADASS YO! if it weren't for him my precious baby would have long since suffered and died on me already! That's all I need to say..im sure you understand just by my above statement that I don't trust my baby to any other Dr. But him and the Staff and head of staff"karin" are nothing short of amazing, my boy is 100% non compliant ,very large, super strong, vet aggressive with a bad attitude PitWieler who would be a great playmate fer a Demon and they somehow figure it out n treat him the best they can through it all...I love them 💙 so much !

This is a great vet. Their prices are the lowest in the valley for exceptional care! All the doctors are amazing and don't press you to spend money on thin gs that aren't needed.  The front desk staff is top notch as well!

I've been taking my cats to the Sr Dr Moon and now his son for over 20 years. They are the best of the best. I'm a pet worrier and they are so kind, compassionate and reliable.  They have helped care for all my cats and dog over the years.  The stuff is amazing.  Karen is worth infinitely stars . She has been a great friend to me and all of my fur babies now and in heaven over the years.

Dr Moon and Karen are the best!
Mr Leslie Chow and Mr Miyagi are very grateful 🙏 …
Have been using this Vet for years. It's gotten even better at the new location.

I have been taking my dogs to Dr. Moon for years and he is one true vet who truly cares about his patients.  His staff are always helpful and go above and beyond for my kids and always with a good attitude and smile.  Recommended beyond highly.

The staff here are super friendly and nice! I want to shout out Dr R'Bibo for the care and medicine given to my cat. He's been struggling with stomatitis and it has gotten to the point where he was clearly struggling. The medicine she recommended brought him back to life and he's a regular cat again. Can't thank her enough!!
Dr Habib is very easy to talk to, appointment was timely
Dr Moon is great as well as the staff. Kind 💕 hearts. I've gone to them so many years it's family

When it comes to health, you should always take your loved ones to a place of healing and not one that's blinded by greed. No matter how sick your pet is this place will deny you an appointment unless you pay them an upfront $75 fee. which is absolutely ridiculous because in times of emergencies when making these type of phone calls, there are times where you do not have your card at hand and are unable to do it. You would think as an alternative they would allow you to pay the fee upon entering the establishment, but they do not! and they are very adamant about collecting their petty $75 before caring for your loved ones. I already had brought one of my dogs here and paid for my appointment with a credit card but the second time I wanted to come with my other dog was an emergency and I did not have my wallet on me so it was very disrespectful how the front desk was not allowing me to lock in my appointment before collecting money from me. My dogs are only 2 years old and they will most likely live up to at least 10 to 15 years. So instead of having me as a decade long patient, they chose to lose me over their petty $75 dollars.

Absolutely loved my experience with Dr. Habib! She made sure to take her time with my dogs and work out the best allergy treatment plan for each while taking costs into account. The price for several services were also lower than other practices we've been to.

I LOVE this Veterinarian clinic.  My original Vet is currently out on educational leave, and I had a simi pet emergency.  Lake Balboa Vet Care was recommended by a friend and I'm so glad I went.  They  (everyone) were wonderful, caring, informative, kind and professional...I was able to go into a room with my animal and speak with the Vet.  I feel blessed to have found such a wonderful Vet for my fur babies.  Thank you SO MUCH Lake Balboa Veterinary Care..
Dr. A.S. R'Bibo ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Wonderful Staff, thank you Dr Habib and Melissa for taking such great care of Pierre
Lake Balboa Vet is an amazing clinic! All the doctors are talented and kind. So is the staff! I love it here. Highly recommend
Very good experience,  highly recommend 👌 They are so caring with fur babies. ☺️❤️ …

We have had the best experience here with our two dogs! I had an emergency yesterday with one of my large dogs and the entire staff was so experienced, kind, and reassuring. They took amazing care of our boy and helped us feel at ease. Can’t recommend them enough!

When I first started seeing Dr. Moon, they were located in the southwest side of Van Nuys and they were called spay and neuter clinic. I believe it was Moore park in Tyrone Avenue. They moved over to Sepulveda and victory since that time I think the service has gone down ever since the sun came. I stopped seeing him in 2023 because one of the technicians. A young gentleman told me that my dog was losing weight rapidly. He said that Dr. Moon told him this and that was not the case. You can imagine how upset I was when I took my Service dog to the dermatologist and the nutrition. They informed me that he was not losing weight rapidly And that who told me that was telling a lie, they have not apologized. I’m done with them. They say that it was because of my attitude that they refused to see my pet. I ask you how would you feel if a technician told you your pet was losing weight rapidly it could’ve been anything that would cause that problem and I did not respect them I just forced my concern, I wish them well.🙏

This review is based off one receptionist so far. We took our 10 week old puppy in for cherry eye the vet we met with told us the other vet was declining to work on our puppy. She then told us she would do the procedure and even recommended we get him neutered at the same time. I asked is she waa able to do it despite his age she assured us YES. We then paid for the pre-op blood test and the test was done. I even received the call that the results came back good. I then received a message today saying the vet doesn't do surgeries on puppies under 6 months . I asked the receptionist why did their office make an appointment for the surgery and why did we pay for a pre-op blood test? She seemed annoyed and put me on hold saying she'd verify with the vet. She came back saying ya no we have never operated on a puppy that young. So again I asked her why is there an appointment in place and why was a blood test done? She then says I'll just ask the vet tomorrow she's not in today. So I then said oh so you didn't verify with the vet. She goes on to say I asked a few people here and we don't do that. She began talking over me and ignoring me say, "why did I pay for a blood test and why is she giving me information that isn't confirmed with the vet we saw". She was very rude and should not give out information that wasn't confirmed by the vet we saw and should also understand my confusion when I was told something completely different by her own office. If this information is true I just want my money back for a bloodtest that wont even matter if we wait 6 months. Everyone else at the office was kind and informative this woman was just rude and very unprofessional.
have know Dr. Moon for 9 years. I want to say thank you to the professional team that works together. I wish you prosperity. Thank you. Cat LUCIK

I recently switched to Lake Balboa Vet after moving to the area and brought my dog in for her annual checkup. I came in fully prepared for the usual upsell I’ve experienced at nearly every vet I’ve visited over the years, where you are presented with a bill full of “extras” and have to figure out what’s actually necessary. To my surprise, this visit was the exact opposite.

Not only was I not bombarded with suggestions for costly add-ons, but when I actually asked if certain tests or screenings were needed, the team reassured me they weren’t and the reason why. It was such a refreshing experience!

Recently, my dog injured her leg and started limping. I braced myself again, assuming costly screenings, x-rays, and a mountain of charges were coming. And once again, the team at Lake Balboa Vet completely proved me wrong. Their focus was solely on what my dog truly needed, no pressure, no unnecessary recommendations, just thoughtful, honest care.

Dr. Habib in particular is incredible. Her expertise, compassion, and patience are evident in every interaction. You can tell she genuinely cares. The entire staff, from the front desk to the vet techs, take their time with you. They answer your questions, share helpful insights, and never make you feel rushed. You feel seen, heard, and supported.

This office has been a breath of fresh air when it comes to veterinary care. I’m beyond impressed and grateful to have found them. Thank you to Dr. Habib and the entire Lake Balboa team, you’ve earned a lifelong client.
Sharp docs and staff and made house call on Thanksgiving day. Been with Moons et al eons.

I believe the mark of a great medical professional is reverence. Reverence for the practise and for those whom you are caring for. Dr. Moon is a truly dedicated veterinarian. I feel so blessed to have found him. Bella is my best friend and he treats us with deep care.
If you have him on your team, you've won, truly.
They have been my vet for 15 years, Dr Moon is the best & the nurses are amazing 💯❤️ …

💕💕💕I looove Dr Moon, always has been great with all 6 dogs I have brought to them, different issues and even gave one of my dogs acupuncture !! ( I’m not sure he offers that any longer) but is fantastic. . Not to mention the stuff , and Karen at front desk ivery efficient, compassionate and accommodating 💕💕💕Your pets are in good hands💕

I can’t say enough about the care and kindness we received yesterday from Dr Moon and his staff. I had originally taken my 16 year old dog Dutchess to a different vet around the corner from my house and they did tests and gave her medication. She started declining really fast. She couldn’t stand up, eat or drink. I called that vet she went to and they couldn’t see her. I am so glad that I found Dr Moon. I believe things happen for a reason and we were meant to bring her to Dr Moons office. He was so gentle with her and was very thorough. I could tell that he really cared. I did not feel that way at the other place at all. Dutchess was suffering and we had to make the decision to put her to sleep which was extremely difficult. Dr Moon, Karin his office manager and the rest of his staff were so kind which made the process much easier on us. I will never go to another vet. It will be Dr Moon from now on. I already referred my friends to him. Thank you so much Dr Moon and staff for your knowledge and kindness and for helping us through this difficult time.

The best vet u can trust...The prices are reasonable...The staff is very friendly...Karen is awesome...I've been taking my dogs almost 10 years and i am very happy with their service...Highly recommended
I love the doctors and staff here.
Great service. My cat was happy.

I took my two cats to the clinic for spaying and neutering, and the experience was fantastic. Dr. Habib and the staff were compassionate and kind, making us all feel at ease. They explained everything clearly and genuinely cared for my pets. The pricing was transparent and reasonable, with no hidden charges, offering excellent value for their high-quality service.

We have been taking our two dogs here for years. They have always treated them with care and respect.
They can be busy and they are worth the wait.
We recently lost one of our pets and they handled everything with care and empathy. 🙏🏼

Outstanding veterinary care. Excellent staff and Dr. Moon and Dr. Habib are the best. I’ve been bringing my dogs to Dr. Moon Sr. and now to his son and Dr. Habib for many years and I feel my dogs get the best care.
Been coming here my whole life. 5 dogs that all lived to be 14 YO or older. My pug is currently 11 and my shih zhu is 16. The best!!
Great service, nice people. Highly recommend!

I have been bringing my dog, Summer, to Lake Balboa Veterinary for 5 years, but after our recent visit, I will never return. The experience was horrendous, beyond disappointing, and deeply saddening. Dr. Grace Song treated Summer horribly and claimed she needed medication without proper justification. The doctor’s behavior was extremely unprofessional; she even yelled at us in front of everyone, causing a scene. It was shocking and upsetting to witness.

To make matters worse, the owner, Kathy Moon, never once apologized for the doctor’s behavior. Instead, she excused it by saying the doctor was traumatized after being bitten once. This is an unacceptable excuse for such unprofessional conduct. Not to mention, if this is true, it seems she would be unfit to perform her duties as a veterinarian because it’s a fact that each dog behaves differently. I trusted this clinic with Summer’s care for years, and this visit was a complete betrayal of that trust. Unfortunately, our primary doctor was on vacation, and this would have never happened to us. It’s heartbreaking to see a place that once seemed caring and professional fall so far. I would strongly advise finding another vet who actually cares about their patients.

First time at Lake Balboa Veterinary Care. The receptionist, technician and Dr. Habib were EXCEPTIONAL. Dr. Habib was extremely patient, kind and informative. She explained the treatment my cat needed. Very reasonably  priced. So grateful for Dr. Habib and her wonderful staff. 🐈 …

I have found the best veterinary clinic. The staff and doctors are friendly and genuinely care about animals. Appointments are easy to make and it's never crowded. Although it's a 40-minute drive for me, it's worth it.

Over the years that we've been clients first with Dr J. Moon and now his son Dr King Moon, we have had nothing but exceptional service for our pets. For established clients such as ourselves, it has rarely been an issue getting appointments …
